scheme_name: Maanki Munda Scholarship for Female Students
other_conditions: Student must be enrolled in B.Tech programme at BIT Sindri in the 2nd, 3rd, or 4th year (regular or lateral entry)
Applicant must not be receiving or have applied for any other scholarship from any source (state or central government)
Must have obtained at least 50% marks in the previous year without any back paper
Must have passed 10th and 12th examinations from schools based in Jharkhand state
For lateral entry candidates, must have passed class 10 and a diploma or equivalent course from schools/institutes based in Jharkhand state
benefits_summary: ₹15,000 per year for diploma courses and ₹30,000 per year for B.Tech/B.E. courses.
